semantics.direct_quantile_evaluation: from_quantiles returns queryable Dataset without preserve or fitting
semantics.automatic_execution: result terminals run all upstream dependencies once per execution
semantics.sample_fit: explicit specification; completed collected evidence is reused without acquisition
semantics.preview: limit bounds output rows; incomplete evidence cannot silently become a fit sample
semantics.selection: omitted retains; None clears; empty sequence selects nothing; unknown IDs fail
semantics.rename: effective total mapping including unchanged identities must be injective
semantics.spatial_default: actual declared covering support; unmatched assets retained with typed failure
semantics.nearest: requires explicit maximum distance; ties fail; distance reported in metres
semantics.source_calendar: native calendar inherited; explicit contradictions fail
semantics.inspection: valid combinations and pinned release references; never fits
semantics.streaming: batch-local checks before yield; complete only after exhaustion
semantics.collection_persistence: portable directory bundle; all selected dependencies owned by bundle
semantics.atomic_publication: local paths only; default no overwrite; destination unchanged on failure
semantics.reports: immutable snapshots; complete and valid tri-state; collected data survives scope exit
semantics.validation_errors: validate returns data failures; other terminals raise ValidationError with same report
semantics.impact_composition: named responses add; duplicate response requires explicit replace
semantics.no_aliases: no implicit trim, casefold, taxonomy aliases, API aliases or historical parser paths
semantics.omitted_selection_default: Ellipsis singleton; None and empty remain distinct
